Title: Export and import securely to Azure Disk Storage with Azure Private Links integration (GA)

Body.Content:
You can use time-bound shared access signature (SAS) uniform resource identifiers (URIs) of unattached disks and snapshots for exporting data to other regions for regional expansion, disaster recovery, and forensic analysis. You can also use a SAS URI to securely directly upload virtual hard disks (VHD) from on-premises to an empty disk in Azure. Now, you can leverage the integration with Azure Private Link for enhanced security to allow data on your disks to only be exported and imported over your private virtual network.

Get started today by checking out the documentation.
